definitions.explanation: The building where classes are held at a school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{校舎|こうしゃ}
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{校舎|こうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}て{替|か}える→建て替える：10541_tatekaeru⟧。
examples.english: To rebuild the old school building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{校舎|こうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{損傷|そんしょう}→損傷：21079_sonshou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仮設|かせつ}→仮設：21123_kasetsu⟧{校舎|こうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Because the school building was damaged in the earthquake, students are taking classes in a temporary building.

notes:
{校舎|こうしゃ} refers specifically to a school building where classes are held, not the entire school campus. A school may have multiple {校舎|こうしゃ} (e.g., ⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧{校舎|こうしゃ}, ⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧{校舎|こうしゃ}).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {校舎|こうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧/⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧: inside/outside the school building
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧/⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{校舎|こうしゃ}: new/old school building
- ⟦{仮設|かせつ}→仮設：21123_kasetsu⟧{校舎|こうしゃ}: temporary school building
- {校舎|こうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧: behind the school building
